'''Indigo-rated constable''' was one of the ranks of the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]]. The rank was directly above [[Blue-rated constable]] and below [[Violet-rated constable]]. Indigo-rated constables served as detectives.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
